note:
First floor, set at the count the tree reads on the day ADR-0052's gate landed. The unit is the OFFENDER COUNT: one counter that counts by hand is one, whether it spells it len() or search_count in a loop, because the fix for either is the same declaration. That differs from pyfunclen beside it, which ratchets excess LINES.

Every number here is what is left AFTER this branch converted 78 counters and six N+1s; the population it started from was 255 len() and 40 search_count workspace-wide. What remains in scope is the part a tool could not prove safe -- a richer @api.depends, a computed counted field, a compute something else calls -- so expect these to come down by hand and slowly.

  core     1     addons  87
  mail     2     account 13
  stock    3     project 5

Scoped like the other per-addon gates: `addons` is the whole bundled tree as one number, and mail/account/stock/project each carry their own floor so a module cannot hide a regression inside the aggregate.
